Board scenes

Known-good board setups. Use these when the board has been changed between services.

  • Sunday Morning (analog board)

    Analog · Smaller services when the digital board is in use elsewhere · saved 2026-05-04 by PLACEHOLDER — deacon to replace

    Per-channel notes
    1. Ch 1: Pastor mic — gain knob at 11 o'clock, HPF in, fader at 0
    2. Ch 2: Worship vocal — gain at 1 o'clock, fader at 0
    3. Ch 3-4: Backup vocals — gain at 1 o'clock, faders at -3
    4. Ch 5: Acoustic guitar DI — gain at 12, fader at -6
    5. Ch 6-7: Keys L/R — gain at 2, faders at -3
    6. All channels: EQ knobs at 12 o'clock (flat) unless noted
    7. AUX 1 monitor send: see photo
    8. Master fader: at the 'unity' line

  • Sunday Morning

    Digital · Scene 1 · Sunday morning service (9 AM and 11 AM) · saved 2026-05-04 by PLACEHOLDER — deacon to replace

    Per-channel notes
    1. Ch 1: Pastor wired headset — gain at 11 o'clock, fader at 0 dB, HPF on at 100 Hz
    2. Ch 2: Worship leader vocal (SM58) — gain at 1 o'clock, fader at 0 dB
    3. Ch 3: Backup vocal 1 (SM58) — gain at 1 o'clock, fader at -3 dB
    4. Ch 4: Backup vocal 2 (SM58) — gain at 1 o'clock, fader at -3 dB
    5. Ch 5: Acoustic guitar DI — gain at 12 o'clock, fader at -6 dB
    6. Ch 6: Keyboard L — gain at 2 o'clock, fader at -3 dB
    7. Ch 7: Keyboard R — gain at 2 o'clock, fader at -3 dB
    8. Ch 8: Cajon (single mic) — gain at 1 o'clock, fader at -6 dB
    9. Master: 0 dB
    10. AUX 1 (worship leader monitor): -3 dB master
    11. AUX 2 (band monitor): -6 dB master
